title: Registration and test-day information

highlights.heading: Check the requirement
highlights.text: Confirm with your university, employer or immigration authority which IELTS version and band it accepts.

highlights.heading: Verify your details
highlights.text: Confirm the scheduled venue, time and instructions supplied by your test provider.

highlights.heading: Take the correct ID
highlights.text: Bring the same identity document you used when registering, following your provider’s instructions.

highlights.heading: Arrive prepared
highlights.text: Allow enough time to travel and complete check-in procedures.

highlights.heading: Electronic devices
highlights.text: Exam rooms usually restrict personal electronics; follow staff instructions about where to leave them.

highlights.heading: Follow instructions
highlights.text: Read task directions and follow the supervisor’s instructions carefully.

highlights.heading: Score review
highlights.text: An Enquiry on Results service is described in the official materials; verify the current deadline and process with your provider.
highlights.note: Live policy, eligibility and fees vary; do not present archive timing as universally current.
